stages.title: Jessica Jones S2#4
stages.text: Vido Arocho is Oscar's young son and Jessica's neighbor. He looks up to her, and she protects him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Oscar's young son, whom Jessica protects.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Vido's neighbor, whom he looks up to and who protects him.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S3#1
proposed.text: Vido drops by to hear about Jessica's latest heroics and invites her to dinner, which she turns down.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A neighbor kid who loves hearing about her heroics.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A neighbor whose heroics Vido loves hearing about.

their_evidence: A.K.A. The Perfect Burger (JJ S3 ep 1): Vido visits Jones to ask about her recent heroics (flying to Mexico), then asks her to come to dinner, but she can't.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Soren is Talos' wife, one of the Skrull refugees Nick Fury helps escape the Kree in 1995.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Talos' wife, one of the Skrull refugees Fury helps escape the Kree.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man who helps Soren and her people escape the Kree.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Soren now works for Fury, and while he is away in space she poses as Maria Hill on Earth to cover for him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Talos' wife, who covers for Fury on Earth posing as Maria Hill.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Soren's boss, for whom she poses as Maria Hill while he is in space.

proposed.title: Secret Invasion#2
proposed.text: In 1997, Soren is the first Skrull to take Fury's pledge to spy for him in exchange for refuge on Earth, and Fury thanks her for her courage.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Talos' wife, the first to take Fury's pledge.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The spymaster whose pledge Soren is first to take.

their_evidence: Promises (SI ep 2): in a 1997 flashback Fury offers the Skrulls shelter in exchange for serving as his spy network; Soren steps forward first in human form and Fury thanks her for her bravery.

stages.title: Agatha All Along#2
stages.text: Agatha Harkness recruits Sharon Davis, her former Westview neighbor, as a stand-in witch for her coven on the Witches' Road.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Agatha's former Westview neighbor, a stand-in witch in her coven.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Sharon's former Westview neighbor, who recruits her as a stand-in witch.

question: In ep 9 Agatha frees all of Westview's residents, Sharon among them, from Wanda's control so they will turn on Wanda. Does that count as Agatha acting on Sharon, enough for a WandaVision#9 stage?

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Emil Blonsky is a soldier who takes the super-soldier serum and Banner's blood to fight the Hulk. He becomes the Abomination and nearly kills Bruce.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The soldier who becomes the Abomination and nearly kills Bruce.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man whose blood Blonsky takes to fight the Hulk.

question: The proposed She-Hulk#2 stage has Blonsky making amends with Bruce by letter. Should the kind move from enemy to rival, or stay enemy (they also brawl in ep 9 before the story is rewritten)?

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Whistler took Blade in as a boy and taught him to fight vampires. He makes Blade's weapons and the serum that holds back his thirst. When Frost's vampires bite Whistler, Blade helps him end his life.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Blade's mentor, who took him in and arms him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The half vampire Whistler raised and trained.

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Blade finds Whistler alive as a vampire and cures him. Whistler fights beside him again against the Reapers.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Blade's mentor, rescued from the vampires and cured.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The hunter who rescues Whistler and cures him.

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Whistler dies when the FBI raids his base, and Blade surrenders soon after.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Blade's mentor, killed in the FBI raid.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The hunter Whistler raised, left alone by Whistler's death.

proposed.title: Blade: The Series#8
proposed.text: In a flashback to Eric's boyhood, a local officer introduces his father to Whistler, who tests the half vampire boy.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Tests the boy Eric in a flashback to his childhood.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The half vampire boy Whistler tests in a flashback.

their_evidence: Sacrifice (episode 8) lists a young Abraham Whistler in flashback alongside young Eric and his father; Wikipedia's cast notes say Officer Flannigan introduced Eric's father to Whistler, who tested the boy.
